paras: Application: Ford Focus ST 2013-2018 and Focus RS 2016-2018 (EcoBoost) Part Type: Billet aluminium coolant expansion tank kit Part Number: 20-0318

The Radium Coolant Tank Kit replaces the plastic coolant tank at the front right of the Focus ST and RS engine bay. It retains the function of the OEM tank while adding approximately 160mL of fluid volume, and installs with no permanent vehicle modifications.
hl: Increased Capacity: Adds approximately 160mL over the OEM tank
Machined Construction: Two-piece CNC machined aluminium tank
De-Aeration: Internal swirl feature helps remove air from the system
Dual Chambers: Two chambers linked by crossover passages
Complete Kit: All installation parts included
No Modifications: No permanent vehicle modifications required
ft: Radium Engineering Coolant Expansion Tank Kit for Ford Focus ST LW/LZ 11-18/Focus RS LZ 2016-2017
